description: A long deep blue wool kaftan with narrow cream-and-blue geometric woven edging along the opening, cuffs and hem, a restrained brown fur collar and fur cuffs. A cream linen long shirt with dark woven neck, placket and hem trim is visible beneath. Pairs of small round metal clasps link across the upper coat. A blue-and-cream woven sash wraps the waist with long tasseled ends. Brown trousers, dark cloth calf wrappings and brown leather boots complete the outfit. No headgear, armor or weapons.
